cards.title: CONCEPT
cards.text: ACTIVE REVISION / 16 new selected GPT Image 2 images: 3 four-bag hooks + 13 distinct body visuals. Photo-led, softly compressed phone-camera appearance, simple meaningful cuts. Objects, hands, clothes, man/luggage, whole outfits and a cafe couple create variety. Approved Woman Over 40 audio, exact narration and deadspace trims retained. Presenter bridge only; full-bleed body coverage. C02/C09 are first frames for later Omni motion; all other body images are held stills. Storyboard delivery, not a new final ad export.

cards.text: NOTES

cards.title: REFERENCE FINDINGS
cards.text: Instagram: 2222 consecutive frames, 30 held base images/collages. Nuamore: 1465 consecutive frames, 28 base intervals, one internal skincare jump. Both mix casual and polished material. Actual iPhone capture hardware is unverified. No measured performance claim.

cards.title: EDIT LANGUAGE
cards.text: Use ordinary photos as complete shots. Change at a spoken thought or named detail. No automatic zoom, decorative edge effect, rectangular avatar inset or short presenter returns. Preserve the approved voice at 100% speed.

cards.title: OUTFIT CORRECTION
cards.text: C08 shows the white shirt, blue jeans and loafers in one readable mirror image. C09 picks up the bag. C10 pays off the same outfit outside. These are deliberate continuity shots, separately composed.

cards.title: VIDEO / DELIVERY STATUS
cards.text: Images are real selected storyboard assets. C02 and C09 still require Google Omni motion generation and moving-frame QA. Later editing/export uses an isolated DaVinci Resolve project after checking the connection. Existing V1 exports are historical.

cards.title: TEXT AND MIX
cards.text: No target captions, titles, logos or CTA graphic. Preserve selected Eleven v3 Creative narration and existing deadspace removal. The references contain text; their frames are clearly separated and never used as target footage.

cards.title: PRODUCT CHECK
cards.text: Eleanor Cognac / ivory weave / attached flap / rolled handles / horizontal oval gold keyhole plate. Reviewed against physical product photos. Plausible visual scale, not certified physical measurement. Designer hook bags deliberately differ from Eleanor.
